ﬁcient passage retrieval to select candidate

ing dense representations alone, where em-
beddings are learned from a small number
of questions and passages by a simple dual-
encoder framework.
When evaluated on a
wide range of open-domain QA datasets, our
dense retriever outperforms a strong Lucene-
BM25 system greatly by 9%-19% absolute in
terms of top-20 passage retrieval accuracy, and
helps our end-to-end QA system establi

fact.sentence: RAG把检索文档视为潜变量并端到端训练[2, p.3]。
fact.source_quote:
To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
We propose two models that marginalize over the latent documents in different ways to produce a
distribution over generated text. In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document
to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based
on a different document. In the following, we formally introduce both models and then describe the
pη and pθ components, as well as the training and decoding procedure.
fact.reason: 引文逐字说明RAG端到端训练检索器与生成器，并将检索文档视为潜变量，与句子一致。

fact.reason: 引文逐字包含2万亿token库、25倍更少参数、冻结BERT检索与分块交叉注意力，与句子一致。

fact.sentence: Self-RAG则指出不加区分地固定检索会引入无关段落，主张按需检索与反思标记[5, p.1]。
fact.source_quote:
Despite their remarkable capabilities, large language models (LLMs) often produce
responses containing factual inaccuracies due to their sole reliance on the paramet-
ric knowledge they encapsulate. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), an ad
hoc approach that augments LMs with retrieval of relevant knowledge, decreases
such issues. However, indiscriminately retrieving and incorporating a fixed number
of retrieved passages, regardless of whether retrieval is necessary, or passages are
relevant, diminishes LM versatility or can lead to unhelpful response generation.
We introduce a new framework called Self-Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Gen-
fact.reason: 引文逐字指出不加区分地检索固定数量段落会降低通用性或导致无用生成，并引入Self-Reflective框架，与句子一致。

fact.sentence: 现有工作多在较大段落预算下报告收益[1, p.8][3, p.2]，预算收紧后收益是否仍成立未知；样本数与领域范围题目未给，标为未知。

fact.sentence: 检索器：沿用稠密双编码器思路，问题与段落分别编码后内积排序[1, p.2][1, p.3]；第一轮取10段，第二轮仅当判停器输出“不充分”时，用首轮答案草稿拼接原问题再检索10段。
fact.reason: 前半句稠密双编码器思路有ev-7/ev-8支持，但“第一轮取10段、第二轮仅当判停器输出不充分时用首轮答案草稿拼接原问题再检索10段”是拟议方案，所引论文未逐字给出该流程。
